verdict.rationale: Lium publishes GPU prices openly with no account or sales contact. llms.txt points users to 'the public prices below, no account', a public CSV price feed is served at lium.io/pricing.csv, and a no-key, no-signup JSON feed lists every rentable GPU node. Billing is documented as hourly price prorated per second, so the published figures are per-GPU-hour rates. missing for 10: confirmation of a human-readable pricing web page (the evidence shows machine feeds and llms.txt), proof that the feed shows a stable per-type rate for every GPU type rather than per-node marketplace prices, and an independent or probed check of the pricing feed contents.
